and ZXing Core 3.4.1 (ZXing authors), Apache License 2.0.
Sources: https://github.com/journeyapps/zxing-android-embedded

Full license: Apache-2.0.txt.

Android scanner support dependencies: AndroidX Core 1.6.0 and
AndroidX Fragment 1.3.6, plus their resolved AndroidX dependencies,
copyright The Android Open Source Project, Apache License 2.0.
Sources: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/core
         https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/fragment
Full license: Apache-2.0.txt.

These libraries decode/generate QR codes locally. No external QR service is used.
